record.r12_reassessment: The already represented C07/C08 work model supplies actual timing, feedback, task responsibilities, shared resources, operating constraints and recovery conditions to the safety facets named in the41 native frames. SC-A01 leaves invalid/stale/unknown feedback unestablished and distinguishes actual permission/gate/context. SC-A03 adds a declared finite thermal branch: with residual heat2, initial95 and hazard100, removing cooling reaches101 at step3, while controlled cooling3 gives90 at step5; with residual heat0, a simple power cut holds95 and is adequate in the model. record.r2_affected_reasoning: R2: An emergency or restart path can displace active work and must account for its actual resumption/state conditions. A noise-driven mode switch or repeatedly retuned restart policy is an intervention whose effect needs a discriminator; known direct corrections and justified containment are preserved. Forecast recovery capability is conditional on the credited regime and mission. The exact quantitative cue must distinguish the required state from a natural band or aggregate capability summary; charting is justified only for its actual consumer. Direct adequate state evidence remains a valid alternative. Forecast-based constraint assurance retains its mission/regime premise. When an actual process result is transferred or selected as a cross-check, its limit/regime/claim meaning is part of what recipients must understand or what error the check can detect. Correct communication does not make an invalid model true, and a correct model does not prove uptake or independent checking.
record.r3_reassessment: R3: Actual recovery credit includes the whole path and its resource/cue regime. A first movement or component mean cannot stand for complete recovery. Shared staffing and manual adjustment can make an otherwise individually feasible fallback infeasible; a physical acceleration result cannot be exported into a human retention law.
